raw_segments.text: At which the universal host upset a shout that tore hell's concave, and beyond frightened
the rain of chaos and old night.
All in a moment through the gloom were seen ten thousand banners rise into the air, with
With them rose a forest huge of spears, and thronging helms appeared, and serried shields
in thick array of depth immeasurable.
And on they move in perfect phalanx to the Dorian mood of flutes and soft recorders,
such as raised to height of noblest temper heroes old arming to battle, and instead of
rage deliberate valor breath, firm, and unmoved with dread of death to flight or foul retreat.
